blocks.text: Light-independent reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein hone wale reactions ka silsila hain. Yeh CO₂ se carbon, ATP se tawanai aur NADPH se hydrogen le kar tawanai se bhari sugar banate hain. Inhein dark reactions bhi kehte hain. Jab tak ATP aur NADPH maujood hon, yeh reactions roshni mein bhi ho sakte hain aur andhere mein bhi (Fig 5.11). Calvin cycle ko neeche diye gaye marahil (phases) mein baanta jata hai.

Dark reactions ki tafseel Melvin Calvin aur un ke saathiyon ne University of California mein daryaft ki, isi liye dark reactions ko Calvin cycle bhi kehte hain. Is kaam par Calvin ko 1961 mein Nobel Prize mila.

Carbon fixation ka matlab hai CO₂ ka pehli baar organic madde mein shamil hona. Ek enzyme, ribulose biphosphate carboxylase (Rubisco; shayad zameen par sab se zyada paya jane wala protein), CO₂ ke teen molecules ko ek paanch-carbon sugar, ribulose biphosphate (RuBP), ke teen molecules se jorta hai. Is se ek teen-carbon compound, 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ya 3-phosphoglycerate, ke chhe molecules bante hain.

blocks.title: C-3 pathway
blocks.text: Chunke carbon fixation ka pehla product teen carbon wala compound hai, is liye Calvin cycle ko C-3 pathway bhi kehte hain.

blocks.alt: CALVIN CYCLE ke gird carbon-moti dabbon ka chakkar. Marhala I, Carbon Fixation: 3 CO2 Rubisco ki madad se 3 ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) se jur kar 6 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) banate hain. Marhala II, Reduction: 6 ATP se 6 ADP bante hain aur 3-PGA 6 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai; 6 NADPH se 6 NADP+ bante hain, 6 P alag hote hain aur 6 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) bante hain. Ek G3P glucose aur doosre compounds ke liye nikal jata hai.

blocks.long_description: CALVIN CYCLE ke gird carbon-moti dabbon ka chakkar. Marhala I, Carbon Fixation: 3 CO2 Rubisco ki madad se 3 ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) se jur kar 6 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) banate hain. Marhala II, Reduction: 6 ATP se 6 ADP bante hain aur 3-PGA 6 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai; 6 NADPH se 6 NADP+ bante hain, 6 P alag hote hain aur 6 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) bante hain. Ek G3P glucose aur doosre compounds ke liye nikal jata hai. Marhala III, Regeneration of RuBP: 5 G3P 2 P khote hain aur 3 ATP (3 ADP bante hain) istemal kar ke 3 RuBP dobara banate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har dabbe mein neele moti carbon atoms aur peele P phosphate hain; baen number molecules ki tadad hai. 3 CO₂ ke liye cycle 9 ATP aur 6 NADPH kharch karta hai aur 1 G3P bachata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki chhapi hui figure mein 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH par teer ki nok in ki taraf hai, jaise yeh ban rahe hon; durust yeh hai ke ATP aur NADPH kharch hote hain (ATP se ADP, NADPH se NADP⁺), jaisa yahan dikhaya gaya hai. Kitab mein '1,3-Biphsophoglyceric acid' chhapa hai; durust hijje 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid hain.

Is phase mein chhe ATP se chhe phosphate groups le kar 3-PGA ke molecules mein jore jate hain, aur har 3-PGA, 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai. Phir har 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid reduce ho kar glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) banta hai; is reduction ke liye hydrogen NADPH deta hai. Is qadam mein 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid se phosphate groups alag bhi hote hain.

blocks.title: Phir G3P
blocks.text: G3P wohi teen-carbon sugar hai jo glycolysis (cellular respiration ka pehla marhala) mein glucose ke tootne se banti hai.
Is tarah G3P ke chhe molecules bante hain jin mein se ek molecule cycle se bahar nikal jata hai. Yeh doosre G3P se mil kar glucose banata hai, jo aage doosre carbohydrates mein badal sakta hai.
Phase III: RuBP ka dobara banna

Reactions ke ek silsile se G3P ke paanch molecules ribulose phosphate (RuP) ke teen molecules mein badalte hain. Light reactions ke teen ATP istemal kar ke har RuP mein ek phosphate group jora jata hai aur RuBP ke teen molecules ban jate hain. Yeh RuBP phir CO₂ lete hain aur cycle chalta rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek poda tez roshni mein rakha hai magar us ke stomata zabardasti band hain. Batayen ke reactions ka kaun sa set pehle rukta hai, kaun si paidawar jama hoti hai, aur chloroplast kis mutabadil electron raste par ja sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: CO₂ na hone par stroma ka Calvin cycle pehle rukta hai, to ATP aur NADPH kharch nahin hote aur NADPH jama hota hai. Light reactions thori der chalte hain, aur chloroplast cyclic photophosphorylation par chala jata hai, jis mein PS-I ke electrons wapas P700 tak ghoomte hain aur ATP banta hai magar NADPH aur oxygen nahin.

items: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O + roshni se C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O; ek redox amal jis mein pani oxidise aur CO₂ reduce hoti hai. Roshni tawanai deti hai, CO₂ carbon, aur pani hydrogen aur nikalne wali oxygen (bhari-oxygen tajurba; Van Niel).

Thylakoids ke pigments photons jazb karte hain: chlorophyll a (Mg wala porphyrin sar, hydrocarbon dum; ring II par CH₃), chlorophyll b (CHO), accessory pigments ke taur par carotenoids aur phycobilins. Jazb ki chotiyan 430 aur 670 nm par; action spectrum is se milta hai (Engelmann, 1883).
Photosystems: antenna complex, reaction centre (PS-I mein P700, PS-II mein P680), primary acceptor, electron transport chain.

Non-cyclic photophosphorylation (Z-scheme): PS-II excited, pani ki photolysis P680 bharti aur O₂ chhorti hai, electrons PQ, cytochrome complex, PC se utar kar chemiosmosis se ATP banate hain, PS-I excited, ferredoxin aur NADP reductase NADPH banate hain. Cyclic: sirf PS-I, sirf ATP.
Stroma mein Calvin cycle: rubisco se carbon fixation (3 CO₂ + 3 RuBP se 6 3-PGA), 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH se 6 G3P mein reduction (ek glucose ke liye nikalta hai), 3 ATP se 3 RuBP ka dobara banna.
